paragraphs: Rabbi Acha Arikha is Rav Acha bar Pappa. He objected to Rabbi Abba, Ellu Kesharim 113b; in Rabbi Abba bar Pappa’s name, Bava Kamma 80b; raised a contradiction to Rabbi Abbahu, Shabbat 111a. Rabbi Acha bar Avin bar Binyamin in his name. He asked Rabbi Ammi, Jerusalem Talmud, Metzi'at Ha'ishah; released Rabbi Ammi’s vow, Jerusalem Talmud, end of Nedarim, chapter 10. He recited before Rav Huna (I did not find it); in Rabbi Huna’s name, Menachot 35b. He spoke to Rabbi Ze'ira, Midrash Chazit on “Set me as a seal”; Rabbah, Tzav, section 10, has him speak to Rabbi Zeira twice. He recited before Rav Chinena, Berakhot 33a; in Chanina bar Pappa’s name, Bava Kamma 80b.
